business_summary: TV Vision Limited provides television channel broadcasting servicein India. The company operates Mastiii, a music television channel that provides youth and Bollywood music genre content; Maiboli, a regional Marathi music channel; and Dabangg, a Bhojpuri regional entertainment channel that provides music and movies. It also provides Dhamaal, a Hindi-language free-to-air general entertainment channel to showcase captivating drama shows, enchanting mythology, and curious crime series. The company distributes its channels, such as multi-system operators, direct-to-home (DTH) operators, and cable operators. TV Vision Limited was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Mumbai, India.
